title:
Chinese Civil Right
Protest Poster 2022
description:
The Sitong Bridge incident caused a protest against the current government and leader Xi. The incident was seen as the biggest protest movement in Beijing after the June 4th incident in 1989. A protester hung a banner and played loudspeaker equipment on the bridge, burned tires and ignited thick smoke. The protesters proposed the removal of Xi Jinping from party and government posts, universal suffrage for the national president, and the suspension of the zero-clearance policy.

The poster has been printed in over 10,000 copies across 15 countries and posted in Tokyo, Sydney, England, Toronto, Hong Kong, Budapest, New York, Barcelona, Milano, Berlin, Paris, and more.
concept: Through this design I hope I can arouse more people’s attention to human rights and freedom, and promote positive social change. My designs aim to provide a platform for voices that have been silenced by the government, rather than convey any political leanings or positions. I DON’T TAKE ANY POLITICAL SIDE.
